role_summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Native) at Cardiff focusing on owning vertical projects end-to-end, deploying AI agents and LLM platforms, and leveraging modern AI coding tools to accelerate production software delivery within a US remote, full-time capacity.
seniority_rationale: The job title explicitly includes 'Senior', and the requirements mandate 5+ years of professional experience with senior-level ownership of production systems, indicating a senior-level role.

findings.statement: The role is fully remote.
findings.notes: Stated in multiple fields and benefit sections.

evidence.excerpt: Remote, Full Time
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup

findings.label: us_remote

evidence.excerpt: Location: Remote (U.S.)

findings.statement: The core business goal is to reduce the time to fund a customer from 24 business hours to minutes using automated systems with human-in-the-loop oversight.
findings.label: business_goal

evidence.excerpt: Today our average turnaround is 24 business hours; our goal is minutes, through automated systems with human-in-the-loop oversight.

findings.statement: Engineers are expected to have rebuilt their workflow around modern AI tooling to ship in days what used to take weeks.
findings.label: ai_workflow_rebuild

evidence.excerpt: engineers who have rebuilt how they work around modern tooling and ship in days what used to take weeks.

findings.statement: Own vertical projects end to end, including customer-facing products, internal tools, backend, frontend, deployment, and iteration.
findings.label: e2e_ownership

evidence.excerpt: You'll own vertical projects end to end: the customer-facing products and internal tools that sit on top of Cardiff's shared platform.
Own each project end to end: backend, frontend, deployment, and iteration once it's live

findings.statement: Candidates will work independently and communicate proactively, reporting directly to the Managing Partner.
findings.label: independent_work

evidence.excerpt: You'll report directly to the Managing Partner
You work independently and communicate proactively; when something is blocked, you say so the same day.

findings.statement: Within the first 90 days, ship a product to production that materially beats the status quo for the served department, measured on KPIs like speed, accuracy, ROI, or conversions.

Ship a product to production that materially beats the status quo for the department you serve, measured on the KPI that fits: speed, accuracy, ROI, or conversions

findings.label: 90_day_prototypes

findings.statement: By the end of the first year, possess a portfolio of production systems with attributable impact on funding volume, conversion, or operating cost.

evidence.excerpt: By the end of your first year:
A portfolio of production systems you own, with attributable impact on funding volume, conversion, or operating cost

findings.statement: By the end of the first year, AI-assisted development patterns introduced by the engineer should be in common use, and AI-generated code must be read, audited, and corrected rather than merged on faith.
findings.label: 1yr_judgment
findings.notes: Expectation on code quality and AI oversight.

evidence.excerpt: Faster product cycles across the team, with AI-assisted development patterns you introduced now in common use
A track record of judgment: systems that scale, and AI-generated code that got read, audited, and corrected rather than merged on faith

findings.statement: Design and launch AI agents that interact with customers, tied to measurable results.

Want detailed direction before you start
